lines.en: I walk on the grass and the grass stays silent.
My hide is the color of the grass here.
One step, one breath.
You cannot hear me; that is how it should be.
I walk a ring around your path.
Blades of grass brush me as if I were grass.

lines.zh: 我走得很慢，只为不显眼。
lines.en: I move slowly, only to stay unseen.

lines.zh: 这片林子的颜色，我记住了。
lines.en: I have memorized the colors of this wood.
I am at the third tree behind you.
I set my feet inside old footprints.
The instant the wind dies, I shift.
Hunting needs no running, only waiting.
Every minute, I change my hide's color.
When the grass yellows, I yellow too.
I stand here looking like a clump of grass.

lines.zh: 呼吸压到最轻，听得见虫。
lines.en: I press my breath low enough to hear insects.
I am waiting for you to turn first.

lines.zh: 掠夺者的那部分还醒着。
lines.en: The pillager part of me is still awake.

lines.zh: 伪装不用完美，够近就行。
lines.en: Camouflage need not be perfect, just close enough.
This biome is my clothing.

lines.zh: 我不动，你就不会看第二眼。
lines.en: If I stay still, you will not look twice.
The mycelium under my skin shifts hue.

lines.zh: 我数你脚步，数到十就动。
lines.en: I count your steps; at ten I move.
I prefer people who have their backs turned.

lines.zh: 光一变，我的影子就错了。
lines.en: When the light shifts, my shadow gives me away.

lines.zh: 耐心是这身皮最硬的地方。
lines.en: Patience is the hardest part of this hide.
The direction you are looking has no me in it.
Two steps closer and you will see me.
I have been at the edge of your sight all along.

lines.zh: 你的眼睛扫过我了，没停。
lines.en: Your eyes passed over me and did not stop.
Do not search the bushes; I am the bushes.
While you blinked, I closed half a meter.
I have been watching you far longer than you think.
The back of your neck feels cold, does it not?
I have memorized that face for a minute.

lines.zh: 你回头太快，我还没站好。
lines.en: You turned too fast; I had not settled yet.
Stop staring at the grass; the grass is staring back.
That gap is one stride for me.
Your pupils narrowed; I saw that.
Keep looking and I will change color.

lines.zh: 你数过这片草的叶子吗？我数过。
lines.en: Have you counted these blades? I have.

lines.zh: 你的视线停在我身上，太久了。
lines.en: Your eyes rest on me far too long.

lines.zh: 我学着你的呼吸，你还没发现。
lines.en: I copy your breathing and you do not notice.

lines.zh: 你正对着我，却只看得到绿色。
lines.en: You face me and still see only green.
Three layers of hide will not stop that.
You found me; now what?
Blood soaks the grass and changes its color.
I do not cry out; crying out gives me away.
Pain only makes me want to hide more.
That one, and I remember your hands.

lines.zh: 别以为我只有五十五点。
lines.en: Do not think fifty-five is all I have.
I retreat, but I do not leave.
The grass will cover the blood.
One more hit and I change position.
Food? Patience is what I eat.
I do not show my face for a meal.

lines.zh: 你举着它，正好标了位置。
lines.en: Holding that up marks your position nicely.

lines.zh: 菌丝不要面包，只要宿主。
lines.en: My mycelium wants hosts, not bread.

lines.zh: 放下吧，我更喜欢追活的。
lines.en: Put it down; I prefer my meals running.

lines.zh: 这味道会引来别的东西。
lines.en: That smell will draw something else.
I am not hungry; I am only watching.
Food would make me visible; not worth it.
You eat first; I will watch.
The pillager part of me lost its appetite.
What you bumped into was a clump of grass.
Do not touch; there is mycelium on this hide.
Now my position is spoiled.

lines.zh: 退开，你压坏了我的伪装。
lines.en: Back off; you are crushing my camouflage.
I could have stayed still.
Your scent is on me now.

lines.zh: 撞一下，菌落就定在你身上。
lines.en: One bump, and the fungus settles on you.
Gently; this hide is thin.
Do not lean in; the grass talks.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的脚了，第一次。
lines.en: You stepped on my foot; that is a first.
Stalkers do not pair; we pass the hunt on.

lines.zh: 我的同族都藏在别的草里。
lines.en: My kin hide in other grass.
A color change every minute; who waits for whom?
No courtship, only who moves first.
The mycelium splits off on its own.
I do not seek a partner; I seek the alone.

lines.zh: 同族相遇，也只是互相盯。
lines.en: When kin meet, we only stare.

lines.zh: 这身皮传不下去，只能长出来。
lines.en: This hide cannot be passed on; it only grows.
Do not ask; I hide even from myself.

lines.zh: 掠夺者那会儿的事，我忘了。
lines.en: Whatever I was as a pillager, I have forgotten.

lines.zh: 我捡东西，只捡能盖人的。
lines.en: I only pick up things that can cover a body.
A rag is enough for one color change.

lines.zh: 这叶子，和我现在一样绿。
lines.en: This leaf is as green as I am now.

lines.zh: 地上的东西，都比我会藏。
lines.en: Everything on the ground hides better than I do.
Pick it up and there is one less thing to trip on.

lines.zh: 我收着它，当伪装的一部分。
lines.en: I will keep it as part of the disguise.
Do not watch me pick things up; I rarely bend.

lines.zh: 这根枝条，插在肩上刚好。
lines.en: This twig fits on my shoulder nicely.

lines.zh: 轻的东西，才不破坏轮廓。
lines.en: Only light things keep my outline intact.
Once I pick it up, I go back into the grass.
You are alone; I saw it.

lines.zh: 背对我的那一刻，就够了。
lines.en: The moment you turned your back was enough.
I have had my eyes on you for three minutes.
The path you took ends at a tree.
The grass changed color and you did not notice.

lines.zh: 我不追快的，只追一个人的。
lines.en: I do not chase the fast; I chase the solitary.

lines.zh: 你的脚步乱了，露了方向。
lines.en: Your steps broke rhythm and gave you away.
The mycelium says you will do.

lines.zh: 别喊人，喊了我就换地方。
lines.en: Do not call for help; I will simply relocate.
You are not the first to turn around.

lines.zh: 我看见你的影子缩了一下。
lines.en: I saw your shadow flinch.
There are only two of us in this wood.
I choose by who has no companion.

lines.zh: 你已经走进我的颜色里。
lines.en: You have already walked into my color.

lines.zh: 你在同一块石头上停了两次。
lines.en: You stopped on the same rock twice.

lines.zh: 你的同伴走远了，机会来了。
lines.en: Your companion walked off; now is the time.
Do not turn; I am already at the tree behind you.
You are half a meter from my position.
Your hand is reaching for the sword; I see it.

lines.zh: 再走三步，就进我的范围。
lines.en: Three more steps and you are in my reach.

lines.zh: 呼吸放平，我不想现在动。
lines.en: Keep breathing even; I do not want to move yet.
The grass blades are counting for you.

lines.zh: 你听见的声音是风，不是我。
lines.en: That sound was wind, not me.
I keep the blade inside my color.
Running now would change nothing.

lines.zh: 这一分钟，我换了两次色。
lines.en: In this minute I have changed color twice.

lines.zh: 你的同伴在更远的树后。
lines.en: Your companion is behind a farther tree.

lines.zh: 我等你伸手去捡那样东西。
lines.en: I am waiting for you to reach for that thing.
Do not tense up; I have not decided.
The grass behind you is taller than ahead.

lines.zh: 我在你身后三步，草替我挡着。
lines.en: I am three steps behind, hidden by grass.

lines.zh: 你摸剑鞘的动作，我看得很清楚。
lines.en: I see your hand moving toward the sheath.

lines.zh: 你往左绕，我就先到左边。
lines.en: Go left and I will already be on the left.

lines.zh: 这一分钟里，我离你只剩两米。
lines.en: This minute, only two meters remain.
Ten points; enough for you to turn around once.

lines.zh: 刀从草里出来，你才看见。
lines.en: The blade leaves the grass, and only then do you see.
Do not scream; this wood carries far.
I practiced this cut for a full minute.

lines.zh: 你的甲只有三层，我数过。
lines.en: Your armor is three layers; I counted.
The grass goes flat; so does the blood.
I aim for the nape, not the face.
You turned around; perfect.
That sound was like a snapped branch.
Do not fall where I was hiding.
One strike; I only need one.
Your blood is warmer than grass sap.

lines.zh: 我出手时，颜色就不重要了。
lines.en: Once I strike, color stops mattering.
Remember this patch of grass; you fell here.

lines.zh: 我从你侧面出刀，你没转身。
lines.en: I cut from your side; you never turned.

lines.zh: 草挡住了你的视线，就够了。
lines.en: The grass blocked your sight; that was enough.
The grass stirred; that was me.

lines.zh: 我从一具掠夺者尸体里长出来。
lines.en: I grew out of a dead pillager.

lines.zh: 这片群系的颜色，我先取了。
lines.en: I took this biome's color first.

lines.zh: 一分钟，我就和这里一样。
lines.en: Give me a minute and I match this place.
Do not hunt for a sound; I make none.

lines.zh: 我站进草里，就少了一个我。
lines.en: I step into the grass, and one of me disappears.
The wind here reaches me first.
I have not decided whether to move.

lines.zh: 你刚才是不是看见了什么？
lines.en: Did you just see something out of the corner of your eye?
Fifty-five points of life; enough to hide a long while.

lines.zh: 菌丝先扎进土，再长出我。
lines.en: The mycelium roots first, then grows me.
The wood is too quiet, is it not?
I am where you were standing a moment ago.
I see you, and you do not see me.

lines.zh: 菌丝从土里立起来，成了我。
lines.en: Mycelium rose from the soil and became me.

lines.zh: 这片草色我记住了，就长这样。
lines.en: I memorized this grass color and grew to match.

lines.zh: 我出现时，一只鸟都没飞。
lines.en: When I appeared, not one bird flew.

lines.zh: 我把自己埋进落叶里，等颜色对上。
lines.en: I bury myself in leaves until the hue matches.

lines.zh: 火把草烧了，我也没了藏处。
lines.en: Fire burns the grass, and my cover with it.

lines.zh: 落地的声音，比我预想的大。
lines.en: I landed louder than I intended.
I cannot learn the color of grass underwater.
Half my disguise is blown away.
The arrow came through the grass and found me.

lines.zh: 光扫过的地方，我藏不住。
lines.en: Where that light sweeps, I cannot hide.
Hunger makes me lighter on my feet.

lines.zh: 雷照亮了整片草，包括我。
lines.en: The lightning lit the whole field, me included.

lines.zh: 掉进虚空，连伪装都没了。
lines.en: In the void, even camouflage is gone.
